NO_JOIN_PATH.title: These folders are not connected, so the worksheet was not run
NO_JOIN_PATH.why: The worksheet uses columns from folders that no chain of joins links together. Without a join, the database would pair every row of one folder with every row of the other and return a meaningless result.
NO_JOIN_PATH.whatToChange: Remove the columns from the unconnected folder, or ask an administrator to define a join between them.

JOIN_NO_PREDICATE.title: A join in this worksheet has no join condition, so it was not run
JOIN_NO_PREDICATE.why: This worksheet needs two folders joined together, but the join between them does not say which columns to match on. Without that condition the database would pair every row of one folder with every row of the other. The join was migrated from Discoverer with its condition missing or in a form Neo could not read.
JOIN_NO_PREDICATE.whatToChange: Ask an administrator to open this join and set the columns it matches on. Until then, use columns from one folder only.

JOIN_BOTH_OUTER.title: A join in this worksheet is set both ways at once, so it was not run
JOIN_BOTH_OUTER.why: This join is set to keep master rows with no detail AND detail rows with no master. Discoverer 4.1 could not write that in SQL, and no Oracle documentation describes what it was meant to do. Guessing would change the numbers this worksheet reports.
JOIN_BOTH_OUTER.whatToChange: Ask an administrator to open this join and turn off one of its two outer-join settings.

FAN_TRAP_R1.title: These totals are measured against different things, so the worksheet was not run
FAN_TRAP_R1.why: This worksheet totals values from two sets of detail rows, but each set is joined to the main folder on a different column. The two totals are not counted against the same thing, so putting them side by side would compare figures that do not line up.
FAN_TRAP_R1.whatToChange: Total values from one set of detail rows, or ask an administrator whether both joins should match on the same column.

FAN_TRAP_R2.title: These folders are joined in a circle, so the worksheet was not run
FAN_TRAP_R2.why: The two detail folders are joined to each other as well as to the main folder. That makes the relationship circular, and there is more than one way to add up the rows, each giving a different answer. Discoverer refused this shape too.
FAN_TRAP_R2.whatToChange: Use columns from one of the two detail folders, or ask an administrator which join the worksheet should follow.

FAN_TRAP_R3.title: This worksheet shows individual values from two sets of detail rows, so it was not run
FAN_TRAP_R3.why: Totals across a one-to-many join work because the detail rows are only ever summarised. This worksheet also shows individual (non-totalled) values from two different sets of detail rows. Those sets do not line up with each other, so every combination of them would be listed rather than the rows you asked for.
FAN_TRAP_R3.whatToChange: Total the values instead of listing them, or show individual values from one set of detail rows only.

FAN_TRAP_R4.title: This worksheet fans out from more than one folder, so it was not run
FAN_TRAP_R4.why: Detail rows are summarised against one main folder. This worksheet has two folders that each act as the main one, so there is no single set of rows to measure the totals against.
FAN_TRAP_R4.whatToChange: Split this into two worksheets, one per main folder, or remove the columns that reach into the second one.

FAN_TRAP_REAGG.title: This kind of total cannot be worked out across a join, so the worksheet was not run
FAN_TRAP_REAGG.why: To total across a one-to-many join, each set of detail rows is summarised first and the parts are then combined. Adding up sums gives the right answer, and so do smallest and largest. Averages, counts of distinct values, standard deviation and variance cannot be rebuilt from parts: an average of averages is not the average.
FAN_TRAP_REAGG.whatToChange: Use Sum, Count, Minimum or Maximum, or total this column on a worksheet that uses one folder only.
